articles.description: Axis Direct report highlights that stock-specific opportunities will be crucial in the Indian equity market. Global uncertainty and external pressures limit broad-based gains, making the market more selective and favouring Momentum and Quality stocks.

articles.title: Milind Kumar's century powers USA to record run chase against UAE
articles.description: Milind Kumar smashed an unbeaten 116 off 84 balls to become the USA’s leading six-hitter in men's ODIs. His fifth ODI century powered the USA to their highest-ever successful run chase against the UAE in ICC World Cup League 2 action.

articles.description: Industry leaders said expanding trade with BIMSTEC countries via flexible business arrangements is critical for India's 'Viksit Bharat' goal, calling for cooperation in fisheries, AI, medical equipment, and education with neighbouring countries.

articles.title: INDIA bloc's ECI protest march meets heavy security in Delhi
articles.description: The opposition INDIA bloc began its protest march to the ECI headquarters in Delhi, facing heavy security. SP MP Dharmendra Yadav stated they would 'do whatever is required' to reach the ECI, criticizing the EC appointment process.

articles.description: DMK's TKS Elangovan alleged that TVK candidates in the Tamil Nadu bypolls are facing voter anger and are distributing money and goods. Bypolls are being held for two Assembly seats in Tamil Nadu and a Lok Sabha seat in Assam.

articles.title: Reliance asks court to quash ban on marketing Campa drinks as ‘energy drinks’
articles.description: Reliance Industries is challenging an Indian court decision that prevents them from calling their Campa beverages energy drinks. The food safety regulator issued the ban due to concerns over high caffeine levels and health risks. This regulatory action affects all high-caffeine beverages marketed in similar ways. The crackdown on energy drinks is described as unprecedented in the country. Reliance's appeal reflects the ongoing debate about food safety regulations in India.

articles.title: NYC Measles Outbreak: State Of Emergency Declared Amid 108 Cases Across New York
articles.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has declared a statewide disaster emergency after 108 measles cases were reported across the state this year, including seven in New York City.

articles.description: Myles Garrett is taking his Halloween tradition to another level. The Los Angeles Rams star revealed he bought a Cybertruck costing more than $74,000 specifically for his 2024 Halloween display. The vehicle became part of his futuristic, dystopian theme and his famous “QB Graveyard.” Garrett says his love for Halloween began in childhood. This year, he is bringing his Field of Fright to Los Angeles with Lowe’s.

articles.title: Flydubai co-pilot allegedly tried to crash plane after hijack attempt failed
articles.description: An Omani co-pilot attacked the captain of a flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv. Following the assault, he attempted to crash the aircraft into the Saudi desert. Investigators are looking into whether the co-pilot cut the engines' fuel supply during this crisis. Emergency codes were transmitted to air traffic control indicating both a general emergency and a suspected hijacking.

articles.description: India's IT services sector is likely to see muted performance in the second quarter of FY27, but increasing traction in artificial intelligence-related deals could support growth over the medium term, Centrum said in a report.

articles.title: L&T wins ₹10,000-15,000 crore power transmission orders in India, Middle East
articles.description: Larsen & Toubro’s Power Transmission & Distribution business has won multiple EPC orders worth ₹10,000-15,000 crore across India, Saudi Arabia and the UAE. The projects include 380 kV transmission and substation works in Saudi Arabia, 132/11 kV substations and cabling in the UAE, and a transmission system of lines and substations in Visakhapatnam.

articles.title: US removes B-1 bombers from UK's Fairford air base amid security concerns
articles.description: The planes' removal comes after several men were arrested on suspicion of a terror plot on the air base, with UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham saying that Britain had "strong indications" that Iran was involved in the suspected plot targeting the base.

articles.title: Viral video captures truck going 'airborne' in deadly 14-vehicle Pennsylvania crash
articles.description: In Haverford Township, a tragic multi-vehicle crash unfolded as a pickup truck veered wildly, triggering a chain reaction involving fourteen cars. Sadly, the driver, a man in his 60s, was declared dead at the scene. Eight others suffered non-life threatening injuries. Authorities believe a medical emergency may have led to the driver's erratic behavior, as the crash coincided with bustling festival activities, allowing for a swift police response.

articles.title: $30 billion sports giant could turn Travis Kelce’s post-NFL chapter into a major media career
articles.description: Travis Kelce’s post-NFL future could include a major media opportunity with a $30 billion sports giant. The Chiefs tight end has already built strong television and podcast credentials through Saturday Night Live, Are You Smarter Than a Celebrity? and New Heights. While no broadcasting deal has been confirmed, his football knowledge, personality and media experience could make him an attractive candidate after retirement.
